name: @pipeworx/mcp-uk-epc

tools.name: search_domestic_epc
tools.description: Search the UK Energy Performance Certificate register for DOMESTIC (residential) properties in England and Wales. At least one filter is required — postcode is the common case. Returns each certificate's number, address, postcode, council, constituency, current energy efficiency band (A-G) and registration date. Counts and pagination are returned ahead of the certificate list. Use get_certificate with a certificateNumber for the full technical record (SAP calculation detail, recommendations, etc.).

postcode.description: A UK postcode in England or Wales, e.g. "LS1 4AP".

uprn.description: The unique property reference number (UPRN), left-padded with zeroes to 12 digits.

address.description: A partial or full address, e.g. "9 union street".

council.description: One or more local council names to filter by.

constituency.description: One or more UK parliamentary constituency names to filter by.

efficiency_rating.description: One or more energy efficiency rating letters (A-G) to filter by.

date_start.description: Start of the certificate registration date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Required if no other filter is given.

date_end.description: End of the certificate registration date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Required if no other filter is given.

page.description: Page number to fetch (pagination.currentPage in the previous response). Default 1.

tools.name: search_non_domestic_epc
tools.description: Search the UK Energy Performance Certificate register for NON-DOMESTIC (commercial) buildings in England and Wales. Same filters as search_domestic_epc — at least one is required. Returns each certificate's number, address, postcode, council, constituency, current energy efficiency band and registration date.

postcode.description: A UK postcode in England or Wales, e.g. "LS1 4AP".

uprn.description: The unique property reference number (UPRN), left-padded with zeroes to 12 digits.

address.description: A partial or full address, e.g. "9 union street".

council.description: One or more local council names to filter by.

constituency.description: One or more UK parliamentary constituency names to filter by.

efficiency_rating.description: One or more energy efficiency rating letters (A-G) to filter by.

date_start.description: Start of the certificate registration date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Required if no other filter is given.

date_end.description: End of the certificate registration date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Required if no other filter is given.

page.description: Page number to fetch (pagination.currentPage in the previous response). Default 1.

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.description: Fetch the full record for one Energy Performance Certificate or Display Energy Certificate by its certificate number (from search_domestic_epc or search_non_domestic_epc). Returns the headline fields (address, postcode, council, constituency, current energy efficiency band, registration date, assessment type) plus the complete raw certificate record under `raw` — its exact shape varies by the schema version the certificate was registered under.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-uk-epc forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the uk-epc pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
